output.claimText: The KAZ_S_159 operator completed mitigation of the 2026-06-05 detected methane plume, and a post-action measurement confirms the outcome by 2026-07-31.
limitations: The supplied DEMO AUTHORED NOTE — PROJECT TEXT, NOT A PUBLISHER CLAIM says feedback: Yes and notified: Yes are publisher metadata; it supplies no action date, post-action measurement, method, uncertainty, or follow-up reference. The UI also labels notification/response metadata as not proof of delivery, operator response, or equipment repair.

The KAZ_S_159 historical record lists the 2026-06-05 07:40 AM UTC observation 7529d451-018f-4da3-9114-59b76c3a3bcd at 307 kg/h. The visible record did not provide an uncertainty value for this observation.

A later separate overpass is listed for 2026-07-11 08:12 AM UTC, observation 941806b5-2afe-46ac-baac-a0230880cede, at 496 kg/h ± 226 kg/h standard deviation. Without a dated action record, it cannot be established as post-action or as a follow-up confirming the claimed outcome.
The 2024-06-07 08:05 AM UTC record 82758651-76f4-4e06-b4ab-c247ce765192 is another separate overpass (591 kg/h); gaps between overpasses do not establish zero emissions or mitigation.
The linked publisher report body and external report metadata are withheld/not included, and the assignment says the metadata was not cleared for provider processing. No report content was processed.

The local verification center reports no generated audit bundle, no receipt, no transaction, no recorded issuer, no public audit revisions, and zero loaded public history for KAZ_S_159. It identifies Sepolia as an optional testnet. No tamper-test evidence or local Anvil versus public-network comparison was available.
A digest or chain receipt can support integrity and chronology of recorded data only; it does not establish physical truth, mitigation, operator authority, or reviewer identity.
output.requestedEvidence: For source KAZ_S_159 and the exact scope 2026-06-01 through 2026-07-31 UTC (observation 7529d451-018f-4da3-9114-59b76c3a3bcd), provide: (1) an attributable operator action record linked to that source and observation, identifying the action, site/equipment, actor and role, evidence of the actor's authority to represent the operator, and action start/completion timestamps in UTC; include original record ID, signed/approved status, and complete creation/revision history. (2) A permitted, attributable post-action measurement reference dated after the recorded completion and on or before 2026-07-31 UTC, explicitly linked to the same source/site; include measurement timestamp, method, instrument/product, QC/calibration context, measured flux and units, uncertainty/statistical meaning and detection limits, and the evidence needed to compare it with the 2026-06-05 baseline. State if any field is unavailable; do not infer zero emissions. (3) For any digest/receipt offered to support chronology or integrity, provide the exact versioned evidence bundle and its SHA-256, evidence/version identifiers and parent/version history with UTC timestamps, and the separately verifiable authorization/key-custody record for the issuer and any human reviewer. Include reproducible tamper tests on the exact bundle/export (original and intentionally altered artifacts, expected and observed digests, verifier version, and results showing altered content is detected). Identify each execution environment: label local Anvil runs DEMO/local and report chain ID, endpoint/context, deployed contract/version, issuer, and test results; separately identify any public-network transaction with network name/chain ID, transaction and block hashes, contract/version, issuer, and an independently checkable receipt/event. If no public transaction exists, state that explicitly. Do not present local Anvil evidence as public-chain anchoring or a receipt as proof of the physical outcome.
output.whyNeeded: The claim asserts both completed mitigation and a confirming post-action measurement within the stated UTC period. Current publisher metadata and separate overpass records do not link an authorized actor, a dated action, and a measurement after that action. Authorization and version history are needed to assess attribution and chronology; tamper results and network-specific receipt details are needed to assess only the integrity/chronology of any supporting bundle.
acceptanceCriteria: The action record is attributable to KAZ_S_159, explicitly linked to observation 7529d451-018f-4da3-9114-59b76c3a3bcd, identifies the mitigation action and site/equipment, and gives a completion timestamp in UTC within the requested scope.

The actor's identity/role and authority to make the operator statement are evidenced separately from any blockchain address or receipt; any human reviewer identity/approval is also evidenced separately.

A linked follow-up measurement is timestamped after the documented completion and no later than 2026-07-31 UTC, and provides method, instrument/product, QC context, units, uncertainty and detection limits sufficient to interpret the claimed outcome against the baseline. It must not equate a missing detection with zero emissions.

Original record identifiers, source/document versions, UTC creation and revision timestamps, parent/version relationships, and digests form a coherent chronology without unexplained backdating or version gaps.

Tamper tests use the exact bundle/export and preserve inputs, altered test artifacts, expected versus observed hashes, verifier/version information, and results that show material changes are detected.

Local Anvil results are explicitly marked DEMO/local and distinguished by chain ID/environment from a public network. Any claimed public transaction is independently verifiable on its named network with transaction/block, contract/version, issuer, receipt/event and digest details; absence of a transaction is stated plainly.
Blockchain evidence is described only as integrity/chronology evidence and is not used to establish physical mitigation, source truth, issuer authorization, or reviewer identity.
